notes: Boot sequence, in order. Files resolve against mods/, the converted assets and the extracted Media folder, first match wins.
Times are seconds. skip.after is 0 in the port; the original ignored buttons for the first second of each movie (original_after).
skip.buttons is any button in the port, so one tap skips one step; original_buttons is what the original accepted (confirm = A or START).
first_boot_only steps are left out when the intro plays again after the title idle timeout.

A rotate step plays its files in turn, the first on boot. The original (0x1372a) plays movie 0xaebf6(n % 2) with n starting at 1 (0x1d6f6c), so phantomcrash.sfd comes first and opening.sfd on the next visit.
Source: docs/OBJECTIVE_01_PLAN.md (scenes 158, 18, 45 and 2 of the original).
